blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Mesh extraction from 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) aims to endow 3D Gaussians with accurate geometric structures, enabling explicit and precise 3D occupancy. However, existing methods primarily focus on scene-level mesh extraction, making them unable to represent object-level occupancy and often resulting in non-watertight surfaces. To overcome these limitations, we propose MEGA ( M esh E xtraction from GA ussians), a “segment-then-mesh” framework for extracting object-level, watertight meshes from complex 3DGS scenes.
At the core of MEGA are Spatial Visual Distillation (SVD) and a mask-guided neural surface reconstruction module. SVD treats the 3DGS model as a teacher, sampling diverse camera poses and rendering the corresponding views of each segmented object. These observations are then used to train a mesh reconstruction model through photometric supervision. Extensive experiments on several widely used benchmarks demonstrate that MEGA achieves state-of-the-art performance in recovering accurate object-level 3D occupancy. Moreover, MEGA enables complex physical interactions by combining high-quality object-level meshes for geometric occupancy with 3DGS representations for photorealistic rendering.
blocks.zh:
从3D Gaussian Splating(3DGS)中提取的网格旨在将3D Gaussians配以精确的几何结构,从而能够清晰精确的3D占用. 然而,现有方法主要侧重于场景层网状提取,使其无法表示物体层占用,并往往导致非水密表面. 为了克服这些限制,我们提议MEGA(Mesh E xtraction from GA Usssians),即从复杂的3DGS场景中提取物体水平的紧水密层的“区块-当时-mesh”框架。
MEGA的核心是空间视觉分裂(SVD)和一个面具导导神经表面重建模块. SVD将3DGS模型作为老师来对待,取样多样的相机姿势,并给出每个片段对象的相应视图. 这些观测结果随后被用于通过光度测量监督来训练网状重建模型. 对一些广泛使用的基准进行的广泛实验表明,MEGA在恢复准确的3D级物体占用方面实现了最先进的性能. 此外,MEGA通过将几何占用的高质量物体级网格与光现实化渲染的3DGS表示法相结合,实现复杂的物理相互作用。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en:
The goal of this work is to extract object-level meshes from complex 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) ( Kerbl et al. 2023 ) scenes, thereby providing explicit and accurate object-level 3D occupancy. As one of the most prominent 3D representations in recent years, 3DGS faces a fundamental limitation: it can be seen, but not touched . Although 3DGS explicitly represents a scene using Gaussian primitives, it does not encode coherent surface geometry. Moreover, the anisotropic nature of these primitives means that they do not necessarily lie on the true surfaces of objects. Consequently, 3DGS lacks the geometric structure required for reliable physical interaction, posing a major obstacle to its application in physical-world simulation.
Numerous methods ( Guédon and Lepetit 2024 ; Huang et al. 2024 ; Chen et al. 2024 ; Guédon et al. 2025 ; Chang et al. 2026 ; Held et al. 2025 ; Held et al. 2026 ) have attempted to reconstruct meshes from 3DGS, with the goal of providing explicit 3D occupancy and making 3DGS representations “touchable.” However, these methods typically suffer from two major limitations. First, they primarily extract scene-level meshes, which are poorly suited to object-level interaction and manipulation. Second, the resulting meshes are often non-watertight and therefore fail to provide complete and reliable 3D occupancy.

Each object is jointly represented by an explicit mesh for physical interaction and 3D Gaussians for visual rendering, enabling touch and grasp interactions while preserving high visual quality.

blocks.en: Why, then, is object-level occupancy essential for 3DGS?
blocks.zh: 那么,为什么3DGS必须占用物体级别?

blocks.en: The answer lies in the need to faithfully model the physical world. Although 3DGS excels at representing visual appearance, it lacks the explicit object-level geometry required for physical interaction. Scene-level geometry alone is insufficient: practical applications require individual objects to be localized, manipulated, grasped, and simulated independently. Object-level meshes therefore provide the missing geometric interface between photorealistic 3DGS representations and physically interactive environments.
blocks.zh: 答案在于需要忠实地模拟物理世界。 尽管3DGS擅长代表视觉外观,但它缺乏物理交互所需的明确对象级几何. 单是场景级几何是不够的:实际应用需要单个物体被本地化,被操纵,被抓住,并独立模拟. 因此,对象级网格提供了光现实化3DGS表示和物理交互环境之间缺失的几何界面.

blocks.en:
To bridge this gap, we propose MEGA , a framework for extracting object-level meshes from 3DGS scenes. MEGA not only extracts watertight meshes for individual objects but also maintains accurate geometric and coordinate alignment between the extracted meshes and the underlying 3D Gaussians. It thus provides effective object-level 3D occupancy while supporting richer interactions and manipulations, as illustrated in Fig. 1 .
At the core of MEGA is Spatial Visual Distillation (SVD) . Given a target object, SVD constructs a carefully designed array of virtual cameras and renders the segmented object from diverse viewpoints. These renderings serve as teacher signals for training a neural mesh reconstruction module, ultimately producing an object-level mesh aligned with the coordinate system of the original 3DGS scene.
In summary, our main contributions are as follows: • We propose MEGA , an object-level mesh extraction framework for 3DGS that provides accurate object-level 3D occupancy in complex scenes and supports rich object-level interactions and manipulations. • We introduce Spatial Visual Distillation , which distills multi-view visual knowledge from 3DGS into a neural mesh reconstruction model. • We present an early systematic exploration of object-level mesh extraction from 3DGS and establish a strong baseline for future research on physically interactive 3DGS representations.

MEGA的核心是空间视觉分裂(SVD). 鉴于一个目标对象,SVD会构建一个精心设计的虚拟相机阵列,并从不同角度使被分割的对象. 这些渲染作为教师信号,用于训练神经网状重建模块,最终产生一个与原3DGS场景的坐标系统一致的物体级网状.

blocks.en: 2. RELATED WORKS
blocks.zh: 2. 国家 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1. 3DGS Segmentation
blocks.zh: 2.1. 3DGS分区

blocks.en:
3DGS segmentation partitions the Gaussian primitives in a scene into distinct subsets, each corresponding to an individual object. By assigning semantic identities to otherwise appearance-oriented Gaussian primitives, segmentation provides essential spatial priors for subsequent object-level mesh extraction. Existing methods can be broadly divided into two categories: offline methods , which require per-scene optimization, and online methods , which operate in an inference-only manner.
Among offline methods, SAGA ( Cen et al. 2025 ) distills scale-gated affinity features from multi-view 2D masks and assigns semantic attributes to individual Gaussians. Click-Gaussian ( Choi et al. 2024 ) aggregates global feature candidates to achieve consistent feature learning across views. COB-GS ( Zhang et al. 2025 ) further introduces boundary-adaptive Gaussian splitting to resolve ambiguities near object boundaries. Despite their effectiveness, these methods require additional optimization for each scene, which typically takes tens of minutes.
blocks.zh:
3DGS分割将场景中的高斯原始人分割成不同的子集,每个子集对应单个对象. 通过将语义特征分配给原本面向外观的高斯原始人,分化为后续对象级网格提取提供了必要的空间前兆. 现有方法大致可分为两类:离线方法(需要人均场面优化)和在线方法(仅以推论方式运作)。
在离线方法中,SAGA(Cen等人,2025年)从多视图2D口罩中提炼出规模化的亲和特征,并将语义属性指定给个人高斯人. 点击广西 (Choi等人,2024年)汇总全球特色候选者,实现一致的特征跨观点学习. COB-GS(Zhang等人,2025年)进一步引入了适应边界的高斯分裂,以解决物体边界附近的模糊问题. 尽管这些方法很有效,但每个场景都需要额外的优化,这通常需要数十分钟.

blocks.en: In contrast, online methods perform segmentation without per-scene training. GaussianCut ( Jain et al. 2024 ) constructs a graph over Gaussian primitives and formulates segmentation as a graph-partitioning problem. SAGD ( Hu et al. 2024 ) introduces Gaussian decomposition to alleviate jagged boundary artifacts. More recently, SAGO ( Liao et al. 2026 ) introduces virtual drones for interactive 3D segmentation, achieving sub-second latency without per-scene optimization. In this work, we adopt SAGO to obtain the object-level segmentation priors required by our framework.
blocks.zh: 与此相反,在线方法在没有进行每场培训的情况下进行分区。 高西亚语Name Cut(Jain等人,2024年)在高斯原始人之上构造一个图,并形成分化作为图分化问题. SAGD(Hu et al. 2024)引入高斯分解法,以缓解错位边界文物. 最近,SAGO(Liao et al. 2026)引入了用于交互式3D分区的虚拟无人机,实现了副二位空位,没有人均空位优化. 在这项工作中,我们采用SAGO,以获得我们框架所要求的对象级分割前缀。

blocks.en: 2.2. Mesh Extraction from 3DGS
blocks.zh: 2.2. 3DGS的网格提取

blocks.en: Numerous methods have explored mesh extraction from 3D Gaussian representations. SuGaR ( Guédon and Lepetit 2024 ) introduces a regularization term that encourages Gaussian primitives to align with scene surfaces, followed by mesh extraction using Poisson surface reconstruction ( Kazhdan et al. 2006 ) . SAGD ( Hu et al. 2024 ) applies the Quickhull algorithm ( Barber et al. 1996 ) to construct collision meshes for segmented objects. However, the resulting meshes are limited to coarse convex polyhedra and cannot accurately capture complex object geometry. 2DGS ( Huang et al. 2024 ) replaces 3D Gaussian primitives with 2D Gaussian disks to improve surface alignment and subsequently extracts meshes through truncated signed distance field (TSDF) fusion. MeshSplatting ( Held et al. 2025 ) instead adopts opaque triangles as primitives, enabling the end-to-end reconstruction of explicit meshes.
blocks.zh: 许多方法探索了从3D Gaussian代表物中提取的网格. SuGaR(Guédon and Lepetit 2024)引入了一个规范化术语,鼓励高斯原始人与场景表面对齐,之后使用Poisson表面重建进行网状提取(Kazhdan等人,2006年). SAGD(Hu等人,2024年)应用Quickhul算法(Barber等人,1996年)为分离物体构造碰撞网。 然而,由此产生的中间体仅限于粗糙的凸轮多面体,无法准确捕捉复杂的物体几何. 2DGS(Huang等人,2024年)用2D Gaussian磁盘取代3D Gaussian原始体,以改善表面对齐性,随后通过截断的签名距离场(TSDF)核聚变提取网格. MeshSplating (Held et al. 2025) 取而代之的是不透明的三角形作为原始的,使得显性网格的端到端重建成为可能.

blocks.en: Despite these advances, most existing methods, with the exception of SAGD, focus primarily on scene-level mesh extraction. Obtaining individual object meshes therefore requires additional manual segmentation or post-processing. Moreover, the extracted meshes are frequently non-watertight, making them unsuitable for representing complete and reliable object-level 3D occupancy. Although SAGD directly produces object-level collision meshes, its convex-hull representation is too coarse to accurately describe object geometry.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进步,除SAGD外,大多数现有方法主要侧重于场景级网状提取. 因此,要获取单个对象的元件,需要额外的人工分割或后处理。 此外,提取的夹层往往不防水,因此不适合代表完整和可靠的3D级物体占用。 虽然SAGD直接产生物体级碰撞 meshes,但其对流壳的表示过于粗糙,无法准确描述物体几何.

blocks.en: These limitations motivate our work. In contrast to existing approaches, MEGA extracts object-level, watertight, and coordinate-aligned meshes from complex 3DGS scenes, providing explicit and accurate object-level 3D occupancy.
blocks.zh: 这些限制推动了我们的工作。 与现有方法相比,MEGA从复杂的3DGS场景中提取对象级,水密,和坐标对齐的网格,提供明确和准确的对象级3D占用.

We propose MEGA , a framework for extracting object-level meshes from pretrained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes. Given a pretrained 3DGS representation 𝚯 \mathbf{\Theta} and a user prompt p p , MEGA identifies the target object and produces both a refined object-level Gaussian representation 𝚯 ^ obj \hat{\mathbf{\Theta}}_{\mathrm{obj}} and its corresponding mesh ℳ obj \mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{obj}} . blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 2 , MEGA follows a “segment-then-mesh” paradigm. It first obtains an object-level Gaussian subset using interactive 3DGS segmentation. It then constructs a spatial configuration around the target object and performs Spatial Visual Distillation (SVD) to transfer multi-view visual information from 3DGS to a neural surface representation. Finally, MEGA extracts a watertight mesh from the learned surface and optionally refines boundary artifacts in the object-level Gaussian representation.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,MEGA遵循的是“当时的部分”模式。 它首先利用交互式的3DGS分区来获得对象级的高斯子集. 然后它围绕目标物体构建空间配置,并进行空间视觉分裂(SVD),将多视图视觉信息从3DGS转移到神经表面表现. 最后,MEGA从学习到的表面提取一个水紧网,在物体级高斯代表物中可选择性地精炼边界文物.

blocks.en: 3.3. Spatial Visual Distillation
blocks.zh: 3.3. 空间视觉沉淀

blocks.en: We introduce Spatial Visual Distillation (SVD) , a cross-representation distillation paradigm designed for 3D reconstruction. SVD transfers high-quality multi-view observations from a teacher 3DGS representation to a student neural surface representation. This formulation combines the rendering quality of 3DGS with the explicit geometric modeling capability of neural surfaces, ultimately enabling the extraction of an accurate and watertight object-level mesh.

blocks.en: 4. EXPERIMENTS
blocks.zh: 4. 警告

blocks.en: 4.1. Experimental Setting
blocks.zh: 4.1. 实验设置

blocks.en: In our experiments, we design a Spatial Sampling array consisting of 3 rows, each containing 72 virtual viewpoints, totaling 216 virtual viewpoints for all quantitative evaluations. We employ two small MLPs for Neural Surface Distillation. For detailed information regarding the structure and specifics of the MLPs, please refer to Appendix 1.2. All experiments are conducted on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,我们设计了一个空间抽样阵列,由3行组成,每行包含72个虚拟观点,共计216个虚拟观点用于所有定量评价. 我们雇用两个小型的MLP 用于神经表面消化 欲了解有关多边劳工协议的结构和具体细节的详细资料,请参见附录1.2。 所有实验都是在单NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU上进行的.

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 3 , to assess the object-level mesh extraction capability, we project the extracted meshes onto the test views and compute mIoU and mAcc against the ground-truth masks. We conduct evaluations on multiple 3D segmentation datasets including LERF-mask ( Kerr et al. 2023 ) , NVOS ( Ren et al. 2022 ) and SPIn-NeRF ( Mirzaei et al. 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,为了评估物体级网格提取能力,我们将提取的网格投射到测试视图上,并对照地面真伪口罩计算mIoU和mAcc。 我们对多个三维分解数据集进行评价,包括LERF-mask(Kerr等人,2023年),NVOS(Ren等人,2022年)和SPIn-NERF(Mirzaei等人,2023年).

blocks.en: Figure 3: Silhouette matching. The performance of both 3D Gaussian segmentation and object-level mesh extraction can be evaluated within a unified benchmark via silhouettes.
blocks.zh: 图3:Silhouette配对. 3D高斯分化和对象级网格提取的性能可以通过硅胶在统一的基准内进行评估.

blocks.en: We compare the performance of existing 3D segmentation methods and other mesh extraction methods on this task to validate MEGA’s effectiveness. We compare our method with several state-of-the-art mesh extraction methods, including SAM3D ( Chen et al. 2025 ) , PGSR ( Chen et al. 2024 ) , MeshSplatting ( Held et al. 2025 ) , and 2DGS ( Huang et al. 2024 ) . These methods represent the current best practices in mesh reconstruction and serve as benchmarks for evaluating the performance of our approach.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了现有的三维分离方法和其他网格提取方法在这项任务上的性能,以验证MEGA的有效性. 我们的方法与几种最先进的网状提取方法进行了比较,包括SAM3D(Chen等人,2025年),PGSR(Chen等人,2024年),MeshStlatting。 (hold et al. 2025),和 2DGS (黄等人 2024). 这些方法代表了目前网状重建的最佳做法,是评估我们方法绩效的基准。

blocks.en: 4.2. Quantitative Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2. 定量评价

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. 1 , MEGA achieves state-of-the-art performance in all meshable methods and SVD can work as a plug-and-play module to improve the performance of existing mesh extraction methods. In addition, we also evaluate the performance of MEGA on LERF-Mask dataset ( Kerr et al. 2023 ) and the results are shown in Tab. 2 . MEGA achieves competitive performance compared with SAGO, which serves as MEGA’s teacher model.

blocks.en: 4.3. Qualitative Comparison
blocks.zh: 4.3. 定性比较

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 4 , compared with existing mainstream mesh extraction methods, our MEGA produces more accurate watertight meshes with well-aligned geometric structures. In contrast, although SAM3D can generate a watertight mesh from a single view, its reconstructed geometry deviates substantially from that of the real object. Other splatting-based methods, PGSR, MeshSplatting and 2DGS can all produce geometrically aligned meshes, but they exhibit large holes on the bottom surface, preventing the formation of complete 3D occupancy. The non-watertight meshes may lead to severe penetration in physical simulations, as shown in Fig. 6 .
blocks.zh: 如图4所示,与现有的主流网格提取方法相比,我们的MEGA生产出更精确的紧水网格,具有紧密的几何结构。 相比之下,虽然SAM3D能够从单一视图中生成一个紧水网,但其重建的几何学与真实对象的几何学有很大的偏差. 其他以镀层为基础的方法,PGSR,MeshSplating和2DGS都可以产生几何对齐的混凝土,但它们在底部表面显示出大孔,阻止了完整的3D占用的形成. 如图6所示,非水密膜可能导致物理模拟的严重渗透。

blocks.en: 4.4. Applications

MEGA jointly represents an object using 3DGS and a mesh, allowing physical interaction engines that previously supported only meshes to operate on 3DGS objects. Our preliminary experiments demonstrate at least two potential applications of MEGA: (1) Human–Object Interaction and (2) Physics Simulation .
We present four examples in Fig. 5 , with the first two demonstrating applications in human–object interaction and the latter two showcasing physics simulation. Additional examples can be found in the appendix and demo video. We hope that MEGA will provide more possibilities for the application of 3DGS in various domains.
blocks.zh:
MEGA联合代表一个使用3DGS和一个网格的物体,允许以前只支持网格的物理交互引擎在3DGS对象上运行. 我们的初步实验显示MEGA至少有两种潜在的应用: (1)人类-对象相互作用和(2)物理模拟.
我们在图5中举出四个例子,前两个例子展示了人类物体相互作用中的应用,后两个例子展示了物理模拟。 其他例子可在附录和演示视频中找到. 我们希望,MEGA将为在各个领域应用3DGS提供更多的可能性.

blocks.en: 4.5. Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.5. 读取研究

blocks.en: We conduct an ablation study on SVD sampling density. Starting from the default setting of 3 rows and 72 columns, we vary the vertical and horizontal densities separately, and then evaluate MEGA’s mIoU on the LERF-Mask dataset. Fig. 7 (a) shows the results of changing the horizontal density while fixing the vertical density, whereas Fig. 7 (b) shows the results of changing the vertical density while fixing the horizontal density. The experiments indicate that once the sampling density reaches a certain level (e.g., 3×72), further increasing the density does not necessarily yield significant gains.
blocks.zh: 我们对SVD的采样密度进行了消毒研究. 从默认设置3行和72列开始,我们分别改变垂直密度和水平密度,然后在LERF-Mask数据集上评价MEGA的MIOU. 图7(a)显示在固定垂直密度的同时改变水平密度的结果,图7(b)显示在固定水平密度的同时改变垂直密度的结果。 实验表明,一旦采样密度达到一定水平(例如3×72),进一步提高密度不一定产生显著收益.

blocks.en: We replace the neural surface distillation with existing splatting-based methods by directly training 2DGS and PGSR using the camera-view pairs generated by SVD. As shown in the bottom three rows of Table 1, although the SVD-augmented 2DGS and PGSR underperform the full MEGA in terms of mIoU and mAcc, both still outperform their counterparts trained independently. This demonstrates that SVD can serve as a plug-and-play module to enhance the performance of existing mesh extraction methods.
blocks.zh: 我们用现有的电镀法取代神经表面蒸馏法,直接使用SVD生成的相机-视觉对来训练2DGS和PGSR. 如表1的下三行所示,尽管SVD加固的2DGS和PGSR在mIoU和mAcc方面都表现不佳,但两者的成绩仍然超过各自独立培训的对应方. 这表明SVD可以作为插件和游戏模块,以提高现有网格提取方法的性能.

blocks.en: Boundary trimming does not affect the mesh extraction results; however, the rough surfaces of 3D Gaussian objects can degrade the visual quality of the Gaussian-Mesh joint representation in MEGA. Therefore, following SAGD ( Hu et al. 2024 ) and GaussianTrimmer ( Liao and Wang 2026 ) , we trim the 3DGS objects to obtain better visual quality, as shown in Fig. 7(c).
blocks.zh: 边界修剪不影响网格提取结果;然而,3D高斯天体的粗糙表面可以降低高斯-梅什在MEGA的联合代表的视觉质量. 因此,在SAGD(Hu等人,2024年)和GaussianTrimer(廖和王,2026年)之后,我们修剪3DGS天体以获得更好的视觉质量,如图7(c)所示.

blocks.en: 5. CONCLUSION
blocks.zh: 5.五. 结 论

blocks.en: In this paper, we present MEGA, an object-level mesh extraction framework for 3DGS. By introducing Spatial Visual Distillation (SVD), MEGA uses the segmented 3DGS as a teacher model to generate multi-view camera pairs, which are then used to supervise a neural surface reconstruction network, enabling the extraction of watertight, geometry-aligned object-level meshes for effective 3D occupancy.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了MEGA,3DGS的一个对象级网格提取框架. MEGA通过引入SpaceVisual Distillation(SVD),将段式的3DGS作为师范模型,生成多视相机对,然后用于监督神经表面重建网络,从而能够提取紧水,几何相通的物体层元件以有效3D占用.

blocks.en: Although MEGA effectively extracts meshes for 3DGS objects, the Gaussian fitting may not perfectly align with the surface, leading to slight deviations. As a result, minor mesh penetration may occur during interactions. Future work could further optimize 3DGS using the better-aligned mesh representations to address these issues.
blocks.zh: 虽然MEGA有效提取了3DGS天体的中间体,但高斯装配可能并不完全与表面对齐,导致微弱偏差. 因此,在互动过程中可能发生小网状穿透. 今后的工作可以进一步优化3DGS,利用更加协调的网格表述来解决这些问题。
